tested_scope: One bounded specification-level audit of Workflow Run RO-Crate / Provenance Run Crate 0.5, with W3C PROV as a provenance-model control, for whether the package itself can preserve scientist-agent evidence and replay a useful scheduled-Chat outcome without an execution handoff.

sources_checked.fact: Workflow Run Crate describes a ComputationalWorkflow plus CreateAction execution records, with optional FormalParameter definitions for inputs and outputs.

Provenance Run Crate extends the workflow-run profile with tool executions, step executions and intermediate outputs and distinguishes prospective workflow plans from retrospective execution provenance.
W3C PROV models entities, activities, agents, derivations, bundles and collections for provenance exchange.

observations: The RO-Crate profiles can represent workflow identity, actual run actions, inputs/outputs, tool/step executions and intermediate outputs as structured JSON-LD provenance.
W3C PROV can represent entity/activity/agent responsibility and derivation chains, including provenance bundles.
Neither checked specification requires domain-specific fields that distinguish scientist-agent observation from inference, encode uncertainty, or carry an exact next-invocation continuation.
Workflow Run RO-Crate explicitly describes workflows executed by a workflow management system; the provenance format records such execution but does not itself eliminate the executor.
inferences: RO-Crate/PROV are strong transport schemas for source and derivation provenance, but as-is they are insufficient as a complete scheduled-Chat scientist-agent replay contract.
Treating workflow rerun as the replay mechanism leaves an external/WMS execution dependency and therefore fails the Phase-1 zero-residual-executor gate.

A Chat-native redesign can borrow RO-Crate/PROV provenance structure while adding explicit observation, inference, uncertainty and exact-continuation fields and defining replay as evidence reconstruction from durable metadata plus public-source reads, not computational workflow execution.
uncertainty: This slice did not test every RO-Crate extension/profile or every allowed Schema.org/JSON-LD extension point; custom fields may encode uncertainty or continuation, but they are not mandatory in the checked core profiles.
No independent workflow rerun was attempted, so no claim is made about reproducibility of any specific computational workflow.

phase1_gate_assessment.residual_richer_mode_protected_manual_us: unresolved when replay means workflow execution; none required for static metadata packaging itself
phase1_gate_assessment.repository_transport_note: Static checkpoint/metadata transport can use the existing lightweight repository API; rate limits must be handled by cross-invocation checkpoint/resume rather than same-run waiting.

conflict_check: No protected-primary state, O-derived state, other-worker semantics, downstream state, shared execution ledger, or scheduler mutation was used. The bounded leaf used only own CLEAN state, current sanitized controls and public primary specifications.
continuation: Next invocation, test one minimal Chat-native evidence envelope derived from this result: require explicit observations, inferences, uncertainties, immutable source locators, and one exact continuation; replay it from only the durable envelope plus public-source reads, and classify any step that requires workflow/WMS/tool execution as an unresolved child rather than a pass.
